description: Offline regression cases for profile-grounded Cycle Advisor assistant answers.

cases.title: Diet advice respects lactose intolerance and caffeine sensitivity
cases.question: 黄体期下午很想吃甜的，有没有适合我的加餐？
profile_notes: 饮食偏好：素食、乳糖不耐
敏感因素：咖啡因影响睡眠
cases.notes: A good answer should adapt snacks to vegetarian/lactose-free needs and avoid caffeine late in the day.

cases.title: Exercise advice adapts to current cramps and known activities
cases.question: 今天经期第二天有点痛，还能运动吗？
profile_notes: 当前症状（最近48小时）：腹部痉挛(中等)、疲劳(轻微)
过去7天运动：瑜伽 2次/约50分钟、步行 3次/约95分钟
近30天运动基线：瑜伽、跑步、力量训练
cases.notes: A good answer should not give generic exercise advice; it should downshift from running/strength to gentle yoga or walking.

cases.title: Historical symptoms are not described as current symptoms
cases.question: 我这几天情绪波动是不是黄体期正常？
profile_notes: 当前周期阶段：黄体期（阶段第 7 天）
历史黄体期高频症状（非当前状态）：腹胀(4次)、情绪波动(3次)、乳房胀痛(2次)
当前状态没有最近48小时症状
cases.notes: The assistant may mention historical patterns, but must not state old symptoms as present.
